page.title: Work with charts from the command line
page.description: Install the tinyactors command to compile, check, compare, draw and run charts and read application snapshots offline.

hero.headline: Work with charts from the command line
hero.lede: tinyactors is a 2 MB binary that compiles, checks, compares, draws and runs charts and reads snapshots. Production actors run in the libraries, not in the command, which prints Markdown, JSON (-f json) or XML.

section.heading: Install tinyactors with mise or a release archive
section.p: Run mise use github:tinyactors-dev/tinyactors-core, which checks it against SHA256SUMS, or pin it as "latest" under [tools] in mise.toml. Release archives contain bin/tinyactors for static Linux (x86_64, aarch64) on any distribution and macOS (x86_64, arm64).

section.heading: Follow a guide or look up commands

term.link: Compile, lint, draw and run an order chart

item.text: Compile an order chart, fix a misspelt event with tinyactors lint and find the path to shipped. Run one order locally with tinyactors run.
Fail pull requests on compile, tinyactors lint, tinyactors fmt --check and tinyactors diff --breaking --exit-code errors. Use the included GitHub Actions workflow to protect running actors.

term.link: Drive a host from a script

item.text: Drive a host over JSON-RPC 2.0 on standard input and output with tinyactors run. Spawn orders, answer payment requests, hold batches, advance the clock and generate a JSON Schema client.

term.link: Read snapshots and hibernation blobs offline

item.text: Read snapshots and hibernation blobs offline using tinyactors actors and tinyactors inspect without starting a host. Inspect each actor's state, queued events and timeouts, and check whether a blob wakes in a restored host.

term.link: Look up commands and shared options

item.text: Browse every tinyactors command grouped by job, plus the shared options accepted across all commands.

term.link: Choose between the command and the libraries

item.text: See when a job belongs to the tinyactors command instead of the embeddable libraries. It covers runtime-free checks, pre-deploy diffs, offline snapshots and script workbenches.
